name: B.J. Reece Apple House

description: In 9131 Highway 52 East, GA, B.J. Reece Apple House grows Apples, Corn, Honey, and Eggs on an independent apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. The season runs through autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
